content.text: In Kenya, where online marketplaces often reject creator applications due to platform restrictions, digital creators face a significant barrier to international sales. Without access to conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-works-how|How Payment]] processors like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-7|stripe]], PayPal, and Gumroad, they struggle to collect payments from international buyers. This is especially true for creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products. To overcome this challenge, a new infrastructure has emerged: blockchain-based payment processing and Cloudflare infrastructure. This post will break down how Kenyan creators get paid internationally using this innovative solution.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This infrastructure is not a workaround or a hack. It's a base-layer solution that provides creators with full control over their digital commerce stacks. By integrating blockchain-based payment processing with Cloudflare infrastructure, creators can accept international payments in their preferred currencies, such as USDT on Tron or fiat currencies through Binance P2P. This setup allows for fast settlement times, low fees, and secure transactions. It's an all-inclusive solution that addresses the pain points of traditional payment processors, providing creators with the freedom to sell their digital products globally without relying on external platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is built around a stack of free and open-source tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments integrates with this stack, providing automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee. With this setup, creators can deploy their digital commerce stacks in under 48 hours, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and test end-to-end functionality. No external dependencies are required, and creators maintain full control over every aspect of their infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are restricted or unavailable. Kenya, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, and Tanzania are just a few examples of countries where this solution can be applied. It's also ideal for creators selling digital products in emerging marketplaces or those who prefer not to rely on external platforms for payment processing.
Blockchain-based payment processing eliminates the need for external payment processors, giving creators full control over their digital commerce stacks.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure include NOWPayments, a blockchain-based payment processor that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, and Cloudflare Pages, a platform for hosting web applications. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script provide the necessary backend logic for order processing, while Supabase and Google Sheets handle order storage and management. Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 are used for file delivery, ensuring fast and secure transfer of digital products to customers. This integrated solution eliminates the need for external dependencies and provides creators with a seamless payment experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure today, follow these steps: Start by selecting a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure order storage and management using Supabase or Google Sheets. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Finally, set up file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With these steps, creators can deploy their digital commerce stacks in under 48 hours, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and test end-to-end functionality.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Cloudflare infrastructure provides a fast, secure, and reliable platform for hosting web applications, ensuring seamless payment experiences for creators and customers.
